title: What's New: Running Tests from Visual Studio Code (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Testing Explorer and Code Coverage Demo

features.name: Run tests in Visual Studio Code
features.description: Added ability to run tests directly in Visual Studio Code with a testing explorer showing all tests grouped by project and code units, with pass/fail status.

features.name: Run profiles for tests
features.description: Multiple run profiles available: publish and run tests in one operation, run only tests, debug tests, or run tests with code coverage information collection.
caveats: Done without specific application added to the system, using only platform parts

features.name: Code lens for test execution
features.description: Code lens elements show how many tests have executed a procedure and pass/fail status, allowing direct execution of associated tests from the code.

features.name: Debug tests from VS Code
features.description: Simplified debugging of AL tests directly from VS Code with multiple entry points: test explorer, test sidebar, or test results. Sets up debugging session automatically.

features.name: Copilot agent for test fixing
features.description: Copilot agent can run tests out of the box, identify failing tests, and automatically fix test code. Can perform multiple test runs to validate fixes.
caveats: Requires run test tool to be enabled

features.name: Test framework using launch.json configuration
features.description: Test running framework uses launch.json configuration to support multiple sandbox or on-prem instances, different companies for test data management via startup company property.

features.name: No support for AI and data-driven test suites
features.description: Test framework does not use AL test runners, which means no support for AI or data-driven test suites, and test code units relying on test runner functionality like setup and teardown events may not work.
caveats: Setup and teardown events from test runner not supported

features.name: Dynamic test isolation configuration
features.description: Test isolation is configured dynamically based on required test isolation property set on the test code unit. Defaults to code unit level isolation if not set.

features.name: Disable test integration in VS Code
features.description: Test integration in VS Code can be disabled using the AL disable test running setting for users with existing third-party test running tools.

features.name: AL MCP for agents outside VS Code
features.description: AL MCP tool provides access to agentic tools for those not using VS Code but using other agentic tools like GitHub Copilot key, Cloud Code, or running in pipelines.

quotes.text: In this release, we have added the ability to run tests in Visual Studio Code.
quotes.why_it_matters: Introduces the main feature of the 2026 release wave 1 - direct test running in VS Code rather than client-based testing.

quotes.text: Part of this is a set of run profiles. There is the profile for publishing and running your tests.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the key workflow capability allowing publish and test execution in a single operation, plus separate debug and coverage profiles.

quotes.text: But now, from VS Code, it's like really, really easy to set up a run and debug.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights improvement over traditional AL test tool debugging which required manual debugger attachment and session management.

quotes.text: the good thing about having integrated with the VS Code tools is that we get the ability for agents to run tests out of
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates integration with Copilot agents, enabling automated test fixing and validation capabilities.
